shots.focal_element: Third-party AI-assistant knot logo printed on the chest of a dark t-shirt, framed torso-only against a white brick wall
shots.what_happens: A roughly 5-frame flash of stock-style footage: a man's torso in a black logo t-shirt, softened with heavy RGB chromatic-aberration fringing on every edge; part of the rapid AI-brand montage under VO word w81 ('And').
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut in a ~0.17 s clip of a centered logo-on-apparel photo, apply a split-RGB chromatic-aberration offset (a few px red/blue shift) plus slight softness, and cut out on the music beat.

shots.focal_element: Gemini wordmark with sparkle glyph glowing on a black screen
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: rounded geometric sans, regular/medium weight, title case, normal tracking, gradient fill with a four-point star above the 'i'; photographed off a screen, not typeset by the video
shots.what_happens: A ~0.2 s flash of a second AI brand: the Gemini logo centered on a dark display, a blurred warm out-of-focus band along the bottom edge, chromatic fringing on the letters. The cut lands within ~15 ms of a music beat (28.7095 s); VO is on w82-w83 ('if you're').
shots.build_rebuild: Show a centered brand wordmark on black for 6 frames with a soft bottom-edge bokeh band and an RGB-split filter, cutting in on the beat grid.

shots.focal_element: Gemini logo (sparkle plus wordmark) printed on dark grey fabric
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: rounded geometric sans, regular weight, title case, white print with sparkle icon at left; real-world print, not motion-graphics type
shots.what_happens: Close-up of the Gemini logo on garment fabric. The contact-sheet frame (29.000 s) shows a crumpled, curved fabric; the mid-shot keyframe shows a flatter fabric with motion-smeared stripes at right, so the 0.17 s shot may hold a fast pan or a sub-cut. A SFX onset (x023, unlabelled) falls inside the shot; VO w84 ('a').
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a 5-frame close-up of a logo on fabric with a quick lateral camera drift, heavy chromatic aberration on the edges, and no added graphics.

shots.focal_element: Gemini wordmark on a dark screen with a defocused fingertip upper-left and flowing light-ribbon lines underneath
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: rounded sans with italic/oblique slant in this version, medium weight, title case, gradient fill, sparkle above the 'i'
shots.what_happens: Macro shot of a phone/display showing the Gemini logo, a blurred finger approaching from top-left and luminous wave lines streaking horizontally below; chromatic fringing throughout. VO on w85 ('marketer,').
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a centered wordmark over black with animated glowing sine-like ribbon strokes beneath and an out-of-focus foreground element, then apply RGB split for a 5-frame flash.

shots.focal_element: Gemini logo printed on crumpled dark fabric
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: rounded geometric sans, regular weight, title case, white print with sparkle icon at left
shots.what_happens: Return to the Gemini-on-fabric close-up (same framing as the s038 contact-sheet frame), with a blue spot of print visible at the bottom edge and chromatic fringing on the fabric folds. The cut lands within ~40 ms of a beat (29.2688 s); VO continues w85.
shots.build_rebuild: Re-cut the earlier fabric-logo clip at a different in-point for 5 frames so the montage flickers between screen and apparel versions of the same brand.

shots.focal_element: Copilot ribbon logo (app icon or wordmark lock-up) on a screen
shots.typography: Brand lock-up: humanist sans, regular weight, title case, dark text on light; the 'Copilot+PC' line is cropped at the frame bottom and both left/right edges, shown very large
shots.what_happens: A third AI brand enters. The contact-sheet frame (29.500 s) shows a macro of a screen with a rounded-square Copilot icon and an oversized, cropped 'Copilot+PC' line with visible pixel/scanline texture; the keyframe shows a tilted phone with the Copilot logo and wordmark over a blurred purple-lit keyboard. Two different images in 0.17 s, so there is likely an undetected sub-cut. VO on w85.
shots.build_rebuild: Flash two 2-3-frame stills of the next brand (a macro screen crop and a tilted device on a keyboard) back to back, each with RGB split and shallow depth of field.

shots.focal_element: Rounded-square Copilot app icon on a light screen with scanline/moire texture
shots.typography: Oversized humanist sans, regular weight, title case, dark on light; cropped heavily at the bottom of frame so only 'opilot+P' is fully legible
shots.what_happens: Macro close-up of the Copilot icon on a display, the screen's pixel grid visible as horizontal scanlines, with the huge cropped 'Copilot+PC' text along the bottom; a music onset (x024) sits near its end. Gap in VO between w85 and w86.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a 6-frame macro crop of an app icon on a screen, keep the moire/scanline texture, and push the label text so large it bleeds off three frame edges.

shots.focal_element: Copilot ribbon logo printed on a black garment, surrounded by curved fragments of printed text
shots.typography: Printed humanist sans, regular weight, mixed/title case, heavily warped by fabric folds and a reflective foil surface at right; text fragments cropped by frame and folds, only partial words legible
shots.what_happens: Close-up of merch: a Copilot logo centered on black fabric with partial words wrapping around it and a shiny foil bag at upper right reflecting more partial text; strong chromatic fringing. The cut lands within ~5 ms of a beat (29.768 s).
shots.build_rebuild: Cut on the beat to a 5-frame close-up of brand merch with partial cropped lettering around a centered logo, filtered with RGB split.

shots.focal_element: Copilot for Microsoft 365 backdrop with a smiling presenter at right (keyframe); a quoted social-post card at the end of the shot (contact sheet)
on_screen_text: Perplexity is actually just better than Google for clear well cited answers. The quality of results and speed to answer is significantly better.
shots.typography: Keyframe: humanist sans brand signage, regular weight, title case, cropped at the right ('36'). Contact-sheet frame: UI-recreated post card with a bold/semibold name, verified badge, light grey handle, and medium-weight sentence-case body text whose lines fade from dark to near-transparent top to bottom; clean grotesk sans (possibly Inter, low confidence)
shots.what_happens: The keyframe shows the last montage image: an event backdrop for Copilot for Microsoft 365 with a woman smiling in motion blur at right, chromatic fringing. By 30.000 s the contact-sheet frame already shows a clean frosted-glass social-post card (avatar, name, handle, quote) on a pale grey background with a soft drop shadow, its body lines revealing with a top-down fade. So the 0.13 s shot holds both, and the card may belong to the next shot. VO on w86 ('your').
shots.build_rebuild: End the glitchy montage on one more brand photo, then hard-cut to a centered rounded card (avatar, name, handle, 3-line quote) on a pale background with a large soft shadow, revealing the quote lines with a staggered opacity fade.
